quest.title: The Suspicious Hermit
quest.description: In the northern Lempo Isle, east of the Nothing Passage, lived a hermit called Derwent who regularly visited friends in Nasha Town. Recently, however, not only has he stopped going to Nasha Town, he's also refusing all visiting guests. The recluse appears to have undergone significant changes in both appearance and habits... There is, however, another notable detail: a traveling merchant claims that their associate, who regularly delivered goods to the hermit, has gone missing after their last visit... To uncover the truth, a direct visit may be the best approach.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So, this time we're investigating... a suspicious hermit?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Aren't hermits all suspicious by nature? Anyone who runs off to live halfway up a remote mountain can't be entirely normal...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: People don't change for no reason, regardless of whether those changes are driven by internal or external factors.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Besides, that missing merchant raises questions...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh? But that area's full of dangers — everyone knows that. Bandits, monsters... There are a million ways a traveling merchant might meet their end out there.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Seeing as everyone knows how dangerous it is, don't you think a merchant who regularly passes through would be well prepared?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Despite knowing the lay of the land, an experienced merchant just disappeared. Something like that rightly raises suspicion.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Jahoda, I'm leaving it to you to visit this "suspicious hermit."

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: It's a long road — make sure you don't stray from the path.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh... Sure thing, Boss Nef! Leave it to me!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hello? Is anybody there?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Mr. Derwent? Are you home?

dialogues.speaker: Derwent?
dialogues.text: ...Who's there?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The name's Jahoda. I'm here from the Curatorium of Secrets. I was wondering if I could ask you a few questions...

dialogues.speaker: Derwent?
dialogues.text: ...You can ask from there. I'm ill, don't expect me to get up for you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (How strange... The Conch Gang kids said Mr. Derwent taught them how to read. They said he always spoke softly...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (This voice is hoarse, but he doesn't sound ill. It sounds like his voice is naturally rough...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Are you alright? If it's serious, I could help you find a doctor...

dialogues.speaker: Derwent?
dialogues.text: ...No need. I'll be right in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright. In that case, you should head to Nasha Town when you're better — your friends have been worried about you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (...Why's he not saying anything? I can hear someone walking around in there, but the footsteps are heavy...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Have you not been outside much recently?

dialogues.speaker: Derwent?
dialogues.text: ...I've been cultivating myself.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yeah, word on the street is that you've recently had a bit of a makeover... Someone was saying they couldn't believe how strong you look — they said you used to look so thin when you were wearing robes.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: And a mask to block out kuuvahki... Is that the latest fashion?

dialogues.speaker: Derwent?
dialogues.text: ...It's to block out the noise.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So you can better cultivate yourself...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Anyway, there was a merchant who came to visit you not long ago. Do you know where he went?

dialogues.speaker: Derwent?
dialogues.text: ...No idea.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: A—Alright, then... Sorry to bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (I'm not sure why, but I feel it in my bones — this is getting dangerous...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (They weren't wrong. This seems like a completely different guy...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (I can't go back to Boss Nef having only learned so little. I'd better stay close and investigate the surrounding area.)

talks.objective: Look for clues outside the hut

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Huh? This looks like... It hasn't been completely burned...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (I heard Mr. Derwent would take in injured adventurers... This seems to have happened recently.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Why would he try to burn these...?)

talks.objective: Talk to the person inside the hut

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (I can't hear anything. Is he resting? Or...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (It's about time I left.)
